title: vocab/taxonomy.json
description: Known technology vocabulary. Not an evidence file: it holds no claim about what Yash has done, only what each term is called. It lives in vocab/ so that evidence/ contains nothing but ledger.json, experience.json, and synonyms.json.

parent.description: The platform this is a sub-service of. G2's services check needs it: without a parent link there is no way to tell that Lambda is a sub-service of AWS, and a bullet naming a service the ledger never listed would pass. The loader checks the parent exists and that no entry is its own ancestor.
